1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

3. The instant petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Cr.P.C) has been filed on behalf of petitioners seeking quashing of FIR bearing No. 407/2019, registered at Police Station Dabri, New Delhi for the offences punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom.
Mr. Raghuvinder Verma, learned APP accepts notice on behalf of State.

5. Issue notice to complainant through Investigating Officer concerned for the next date of hearing.
6.
7. In the meanwhile, the learned Trial Court is requested to adjourn the matter to a date later than the date fixed by this Court.
8. The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
